ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The Spain file is in the brown drawer. ... The Egypt file is in the grey drawer. ... The Chile file is in the white drawer. ... Which colour is the drawer that holds the file on the country whose capital is Santiago?" -> answer org white; the alt prompt asks about the Egypt (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: grey (answer of bridge alt's statement), brown (answer at the same statement slot), orange (the alt prompt's own answer), white (answer org kept).
